source: NASA FIRMS annual country CSV Brazil 2022-2024

filters.aggregation: 1-degree spatial cells x local solar month, count of pixel detections
filters.important: Files are per UTC year; observations falling into an adjacent local-solar year were excluded, and boundary-year completeness has not been proven.

metric: WAPE = sum(abs(MODIS - predicted))/sum(MODIS); reference is MODIS detections not ground truth fires
scientific_status: Demonstrates count-scale comparability against Aqua for limited regions and years only. No validation of true fire counts, cloud coverage, NOAA-21 operational ingestion, Terra historical bridging, physical hotspot harmonization, calibrated uncertainty intervals, or entire 2000-2026 calendar.
